target.title: fix(secrets): reject inherited exec response ids
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users resolving exec-backed SecretRefs could get inherited Object prototype members treated as provider response entries when the requested id matched names such as `toString`.

## Why This Change Was Made

Exec provider responses now check `values` and `errors` with own-property membership before accepting an id. The change is scoped to exec response parsing and keeps the existing missing-id and per-id error behavior.

## User Impact

Users and operators get deterministic SecretRef failures when an exec provider omits a requested id, including ids that collide with Object prototype names, instead of accidentally reading inherited values.

## Evidence

- `git diff --check`
- `node scripts/test-projects.mjs src/secrets/resolve.test.ts` (27 tests passed)
- Pre-PR collision check: no open PRs touched `src/secrets/resolve.ts` or `src/secrets/resolve.test.ts`; no open PR covered exec response id inherited-key handling.
